assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, gastrocnemius medial belly, female C57BL/6NJ mice (S2.11.p1, S3.7.p1, FIG3)

group: Activity Reduction (treadmill 4 wk then 2 wk inactive)

sample_inclusion: RNA-seq on female mice only, n = 7 per group (S3.7.p1, FIG3 legend); males not sequenced
primary_estimand: Effect of regular treadmill exercise on the gastrocnemius transcriptome (Active vs Inactive), plus the effect of 2 weeks of activity reduction relative to the inactive and active controls
planned_contrasts: Activity Reduction vs Inactive (FIG3b; paper: 40 DEGs)
Activity Reduction vs Active (FIG3c; paper: 124 DEGs)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one sample per independent mouse
paper_method: DESeq2 ~ group, each pairwise comparison fitted on the two groups' samples only (authors' Figure 3.Rmd: subset columns, design ~group, results(contrast=...), no lfcShrink, rowSums>0 prefilter)
paper_results: 71/40/124 DEGs (S3.7.p1); 7 transcripts unique to Activity Reduction (Smyd2, En1, Hoxa11os up; Ostn, Ak4, Srrm4os, Zfhx4 down); Igfbp5 down in Active and AR vs Inactive; 16 Active-unique transcripts (S3.7.p1)
